addr: 1473 38TH CROSS, 11th Main Rd, T Block, 4th Block, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560041, India

rev.t: Visited Kanara Scoops and had an amazing experience! The tiramisu was top-notch with rich coffee flavor, the muskmelon sundae was pure muskmelon bliss and super refreshing, and the chocolate cake sundae was intensely chocolatey and …

I could soo much related the icream to the Pabbas!
I had all my memories refreshed and made my day! …

We tried old school gadbad and marzi - paan gulkand sundae. They say gulbad is good here and it was good actually but not that much ..personally we loved this marzi paan gulkand sundae. And the environment is good and also the service is fast.
